note: First magpie survey. Top items by (impact x confidence x reach x kind) / effort. Accept/reject via decisions.jsonl.

items.pitch: The seeded ACL makes /public/alarm/alarms.jsonld world-writable (foaf:Agent gets Read+Write), so anyone on the internet can read/alter/delete a user’s alarms — tighten to owner-only write.
seedPodFiles() unconditionally overwrites <root>/index.html (and signin/account/docs) on every start, clobbering user content; no opt-out, and it diverges from JSS which seeds skip-if-exists.

Top-level `permission: Notification.permission` throws ReferenceError on browsers without the Notification API (iOS Safari), killing the module so the app renders nothing — guard with "Notification" in window.
Alarms only fire when a 1s tick lands on seconds===0, so background-tab timer throttling silently skips alarms — track last-checked minute instead.
Add a GitHub Actions workflow running npm test — 63 test files and a node --test script but zero CI.
Shell command injection via a crafted voucher URI: the voucher chain segment is interpolated into an execSync git-config string where $(...) executes; switch to execFileSync.
README links to the defunct Inrupt Solid portal (solid.inrupt.com) and a dead Gitter room/badge; replace with live Solid community links.
LiteralFrom.base64/hex call Uint8Array.toBase64()/toHex(), which do not exist on the package minimum Node 24, so both mappers throw TypeError at runtime.
Mirror clone is EMPTY (0 git objects, no refs) despite recent pushes — gh-sync failed to fetch content; needs re-clone.

acpToWac emits acp:PublicAgent as acl:agent foaf:Agent instead of acl:agentClass foaf:Agent, producing WAC servers will not treat as public.
The first NIP-134 spec example flattens the u and d tags into one malformed 4-element array — should be two separate tags.
